import { Aside } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

Two macOS-specific facts conspire to make the first-boot dogfood `git clone`
(and thus the whole setup wizard) fail on a **fresh** Mac — with a useless
generic "Setting up Papercusp workspace failed".

## 1. A packaged GUI app gets a MINIMAL PATH

launchd starts a `.app` with `PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin` — it does
**not** inherit your shell's PATH. So **`/opt/homebrew/bin`** (Apple-Silicon
Homebrew's prefix, where `gh`/`git`/`kopia` live for most users) is absent. The
Rust side (`main.rs`) already prepends the bundled `sidecar/bin` (node, gh, …),
but the old PATH lists in `serve.ts` / `terminal-spawn.ts` listed only
`/usr/local/bin` (Intel Homebrew) — never `/opt/homebrew/bin`. Meanwhile the
DETECTION sites (`preflight.ts`, `agent-auth-detect.ts`) *did* probe
`/opt/homebrew/bin` — so the app reported "gh installed" while execution
couldn't run it. Fixed by routing every PATH through `tool-path.ts`
(`standardToolDirs` / `ensureToolPathEnv`), which includes both Homebrew prefixes.

## 2. macOS does NOT ship a working git by default

`build-desktop-sidecar.sh` vendors `git` only on Windows (MinGit), assuming
"macOS/Linux ship git by default". **False for macOS:** a Mac without Xcode
Command Line Tools has only the `/usr/bin/git` **stub**, which on
non-interactive invocation prints `xcode-select: note: no developer tools were
found …` and exits non-zero (it would otherwise pop a GUI install dialog). The
sidecar bundles `gh`/`node`/`omp`/`pg_*` but **not** `git`.

<Aside type="caution" title="Immediate unblock (no rebuild needed)">
On a fresh Mac the existing build's clone works once git is present: run
`xcode-select --install` (or `brew install git`) in the VM, then retry setup.
`gh` is bundled and `gh auth setup-git` is already wired, so the credential
helper resolves — only `git` itself was missing.
</Aside>

## What ships now (mitigations)

- `serve.ts` → `ensureToolPathEnv()` puts `/opt/homebrew/bin` on the sidecar
  PATH (runs on darwin even without `PAPERCUSP_SIDECAR_BIN`), so a Homebrew
  git/gh is found.
- `clone-github.ts` `isGitUnavailable()` detects the CLT-stub stderr →
  `git_missing` with an actionable message (`xcode-select --install` /
  `brew install git`).
- The wizard (`BootstrapFinishGate` / `DogfoodBootstrapBanner`) shows the install
  hint and does **not** auto-retry a git-missing error (it's a user-action error,
  not transient — distinct from the network-timeout auto-retry path).
- `bootstrap-papercusp-pot.ts` now logs the real clone failure (code + git
  stderr) — the diagnostic that was missing cost a full live debugging round.

## The robust fix (deferred — needs a Mac build box)

Vendor a relocatable git for macOS in the sidecar (mirror the Windows MinGit
approach) so a truly fresh Mac works zero-friction — tracked as **EI-3620**.
macOS has no official portable git; evaluate a relocatable Homebrew bottle (with
`install_name_tool` rpath fixups), a static build, or auto-triggering
`xcode-select --install`. Must be per-arch (arm64 + x64), signed/notarized.
Same class of risk: verify the bundled embedded-Postgres / `pg_*` binary arch
matches the app arch on a real Mac build.
